title: Air Brow Clear + Clean Lifting Treatment Eyebrow Gel with Lamination Effect

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, fragranceFree, peptides

descriptionHtml:
✓ Without Silicones✓ Good for: Hair Thinning✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Long-wearing
What it is: A clean, clear brow gel boosted by hair care actives that fluffs, lifts, and sets brows in place while helping them reach their full growth potential.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Panthenol Pro Vitamin B5: Helps revive brows.
- Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1: Supports healthier, fuller hair.
- Hyaluronic Acid + Trehalose: Strengthens and conditions hair.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is gluten-free and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Air Brow Clear + Clean Lifting Treatment Eyebrow Gel creates a fuller appearance with biodegradable, plant-based fibers and a triangular spoolie that lifts each hair. It grooms and adds natural sheen for an effortless, unfussy look.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Brush upward to lift and lock your brows in place.
-Use the flat side to fluff and the tapered point for shaping.

Layering Tip:
Wear it solo as your easy, everyday brow gel, or layer it over your Brow Pop Pencil and/or Air Brow Tinted Clean Volumizing Eyebrow Gel (both sold separately) to fully set your look.

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is formulated without a list of over 50 ingredients, including sulfates (SLS and SLES), parabens, phthalates, and more. For the full list, check out the Ingredients tab.
Ingredients+
-Panthenol Pro Vitamin B5: Helps revive brows.
-Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1: Supports healthier, fuller hair.
-Hyaluronic Acid + Trehalose: Strengthens and conditions hair.

Aqua, Pullulan, Glycerin, Sorbitol, Xanthan Gum, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1, Trehalose, Acacia Senegal Gum, Polylactic Acid, Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate.

The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
